rows.evidence: Q1: Materials and methods / Results <U+2014> two-year field experiment (2015<U+2013>2016) at Sichuan Agricultural University farm comparing soybean morphology, leaf anatomy, photosynthesis and yield under two maize-soybean relay-strip intercropping row configurations (A1, A2) and sole soybean (CK).
rows.notes: The study contains no irrigation treatment, no drip fertigation, and no measurement of maize root development or water uptake. It is a shading/light-recovery study of soybean in maize-soybean relay-strip intercropping; irrigation is not even described in the methods. Soybean yield per plant was 54.69% and 16.83% lower under A1 and A2 than sole cropping (Table 6). Nothing supports the claim of a 34% increase in corn root development or higher grain yield from drip fertigation; the citation appears to be misattributed.

notes: Full text appears complete. The study is unrelated to drip irrigation or fertigation; the review's attribution of a corn root development result to this paper is erroneous.
